description: Athlete's knee flared up, Dean cancelled Saturday's interval workout with no replacement. Haiku must drop Saturday from the sessions list and leave others unchanged.
user_message: My knee started aching after yesterday's run. Should I do the intervals Saturday?
coach_response: Skip Saturday's intervals — not worth the risk with a flare-up. Keep Thursday easy and Sunday long but back off the pace if the knee talks to you. Let the knee settle, we'll pick up quality next week.

expected.notes: Saturday intervals cancelled with no replacement — omitted from sessions. Thursday and Sunday preserved unchanged. key_workout null (no quality session this week).
